title: ALP Target Constraints
description: Platform-neutral goal of and limits on how a shared Learning Target may be adapted, an input to the Target Adaptation Projection (ADR-0060). Without constraints every adaptation mode is allowed.

allowedModes.description: Modes a unit may take. full is always required so every unit has an allowed mode.

requiredUnits.description: Declared-stable unit item IDs that may never be skipped.

goal.description: Competency IDs the target is for. Curriculum Specifications propose units for goal competencies (and their unshown prerequisites) the target's content does not cover yet; a new target's skeleton is derived from them. Each must belong to a domain pack the target's mapping declares.
